cases.title: 黑白排版侧脸肖像海报
cases.prompt_zh:
【使用方式】根据上传的参考图生成新肖像，保持人脸特征与身份不变。
【主体】人物侧脸特写，突出鲜明的面部特征（发型、胡须或轮廓线条），脸部以粗黑剪影块面与利落负空间构建，带粗糙墨迹边缘与碎片化模板镂空形状
【服装造型】无特殊要求，人物的颈部与身体区域融入排版设计本身
【场景背景】米白色极简纸面背景，非对称版式，竖版裁切构图，画面中带编辑风小字、竖排文字点缀与手写书法笔触
【灯光】无特殊要求，以黑白高对比平面印刷效果呈现
【风格质感】实验编辑风海报设计，生墨印刷质感；颈部与身体区域内嵌一块大号可读文字（2–4 行堆叠），用粗大涂写字体与剪影融为一体，页脚附近带一个图形 logo
cases.prompt_en: High-contrast black and white typographic portrait poster of [HUMAN], shown in side profile with [FEATURE]. Build the portrait with bold black silhouette blocks, sharp negative space, rough ink edges, fragmented stencil shapes, tiny editorial microtext, vertical typographic accents and expressive hand-drawn calligraphic marks. Integrate one large readable text block saying “[TEXT]” in 2 to 4 stacked lines, placed only inside the neck and body area, using oversized scribbled lettering that feels fused into the silhouette. Include a graphic design logo reading “[LOGO]” near the footer. Minimal off-white paper background, asymmetrical layout, cropped vertical composition, experimental editorial poster design, raw ink print texture, aspect ratio 4:5.

cases.title: 粗粝手绘搭档肖像海报
cases.prompt_zh:
【使用方式】根据上传的参考图生成新肖像，保持人脸特征与身份不变。
【主体】人物半身大特写，面部放大居中，裁切至胸部中段；身旁紧挨一只动物搭档，位于画面下前景或贴在人物身侧，同为简化粗线条画法
【服装造型】日常休闲服装，以破线条勾勒与扁平色块阴影简化呈现，不刻画细节
【场景背景】极简背景，仅用 2–3 个大胆剪影形状概括景物，不做细致环境渲染；画面带一条暖米白色海报边框与轻微印刷质感
【灯光】无特殊要求，以扁平 cel 式色块阴影代替真实光影
【风格质感】粗粝表现主义手绘插画：破碎的黑色墨线、松散速写线、刮擦排线、不均匀笔触与不完美边缘，简化解剖；克制的色板（一个主导暖色场 + 一个冷色对位场 + 深色墨影 + 少量浅色高光），态度鲜明、充满海报能量
cases.prompt_en: Raw sketchy graphic portrait poster of [HUMAN] wearing [CLOTHING], half-body and large in frame, accompanied closely by [ANIMAL], with a minimal [SCENERY] background. Render in a rough expressive illustrated style with broken black ink contours, loose sketch lines, scratchy hatching, irregular stroke weight, imperfect line edges, fast gestural mark-making, simplified anatomy, flat cel-like shadow blocks, and reduced detail. Use a restrained [COLORS] palette with one dominant warm field, one cool counter-field, dark inked shadows, and a few pale highlight accents. Keep the face oversized and central, crop around mid-torso, and place the animal in the lower foreground or tucked beside the subject, drawn with the same simplified raw linework. Reduce the scenery into only 2 or 3 bold silhouette shapes behind the subject, with no detailed environment rendering. Add a narrow warm off-white poster border and very light print texture. Strong attitude, graphic poster energy, intentionally imperfect strokes, raw and sketchy finish, ar 4:5

cases.title: 春日樱花回眸电影人像
cases.prompt_zh:
【使用方式】根据上传的参考图生成新肖像，保持人脸特征与身份不变。
【主体】年轻女性，背对镜头缓行后轻回眸，浅笑，神情温柔神秘，长发随风自然飘动，超写实肤质
【服装造型】飘逸的天然亚麻长裙，随风轻摆，布料褶皱真实自然
【场景背景】春日午后樱花小径，粉色花冠覆顶，花瓣在空中缓缓飘落，氛围梦幻治愈
【灯光】温暖春日阳光透过樱花枝叶，体积光，柔和环境阴影，带轻微雾气感
【风格质感】电影感编辑肖像，85mm 镜头，浅景深奶油虚化 bokeh，胶片美学，梦幻粉彩色调，优雅浪漫、永恒氛围
cases.prompt_en: WHISPERS OF SPRING. Scene: A peaceful pathway beneath blooming cherry blossom trees during a warm spring afternoon. Pink blossoms fill the canopy overhead while delicate petals drift gracefully through the air. Soft sunlight filters through the branches, creating a dreamy and enchanting atmosphere. Subject: A young woman walks away from the camera before gently turning her head over her shoulder with a soft, mysterious smile. She wears a flowing natural linen dress that moves gracefully with the breeze, highlighting her delicate facial features and effortless elegance. Detail: Wind carries countless pink cherry blossom petals across the frame while warm sunlight creates glowing highlights throughout the scene. Every strand of hair moves naturally in the breeze, with ultra realistic skin texture, lifelike fabric folds, soft floral surroundings, and subtle atmospheric haze enhancing the cinematic realism. Atmosphere: Elegant, peaceful, romantic, dreamy, timeless, cinematic, graceful, and enchanting. Lighting: Warm spring sunlight filtering through cherry blossom branches, soft natural illumination, glowing highlights, volumetric light rays, gentle ambient shadows, and subtle atmospheric haze. Composition: Cinematic editorial portrait captured with an 85mm lens, featuring the subject in a three-quarter over-the-shoulder pose. Shallow depth of field, creamy bokeh, balanced framing with flowering trees, soft leading lines, and immersive visual storytelling. Style: Photorealistic, masterpiece, editorial fashion photography, analog film aesthetic, dreamy pastel color palette, ultra realistic skin texture, highly detailed, shallow depth of field, creamy bokeh, atmospheric haze, HDR, cinematic realism, 8K.

cases.title: 同脸十二发型图鉴
cases.prompt_zh:
【使用方式】根据上传的参考图生成新肖像，保持人脸特征与身份不变。
【主体】同一个人物的 12 宫格发型图鉴（3 列 × 4 行，编号 1–12），每格只有发型（形状、长度、造型）不同；面部骨骼、下颌线、颧骨、鼻型、唇形、眼型眼距、眉毛、肤色与皮肤纹理在每一格完全一致，不美化、不瘦脸，同年龄同表情；眼睛全程可见，不戴墨镜
【服装造型】服装、妆容、配饰（耳环、项链、眼镜等）与参考图完全一致，逐格复制不增减；发色全程不变，只改发型形状、长度与造型。12 款发型：精灵短发、经典波波头、过肩长卷发、低发髻、窗帘刘海中长发、高马尾、法式波波、长直中分、狼尾碎发、优雅盘发、短卷发、侧分好莱坞波浪
【场景背景】每格均为纯色浅灰影棚背景，均匀平整，无任何物体、纹理与渐变
【灯光】影棚肖像光，柔和主光 + 轻微补光，12 格曝光与色调完全一致
【风格质感】Canon EOS R5 + 85mm f/1.4 拍摄感，浅景深、面部锐利对焦，自然肤质可见毛孔，发丝真实，无塑料感；超写实摄影，每格左上角标注编号，整体画幅 4:5
cases.prompt_en:
Create a 12-panel grid (3 columns × 4 rows, numbered 1 to 12) showing the SAME person from the reference photo with 12 different hairstyles. This is a hairstyle lookbook. Final image aspect ratio: 4:5 (vertical/portrait).
THE ONLY THING THAT CHANGES BETWEEN PANELS IS THE HAIR ON THE HEAD (shape, style and length only). Everything else stays exactly as in the reference photo.
Identity Anchor (Critical)
The face must be IDENTICAL to the reference photo in every single panel. Preserve exactly: facial bone structure, jawline, cheekbones, nose shape, lips, eye shape and spacing, eyebrows, skin tone, skin texture (pores, natural imperfections), and overall facial proportions. This is the same real person in all 12 frames. Do NOT beautify, slim, or alter the face. Same age, same expression as in the reference.
Mandatory Rules (Do Not Violate)
- NO SUNGLASSES. Eyes must be fully visible in all 12 panels.
- NO ENVIRONMENTAL BACKGROUNDS. Every panel must have a plain, uniform, solid light grey studio backdrop with zero objects, zero textures, zero gradients. Just flat neutral grey.
- Hair COLOR stays exactly as it appears in the reference photo in all 12 panels. Only the shape, length and style changes, never the color.
Keep Identical in Every Panel (Do Not Change)
- MAKEUP AND SKIN: If the person in the reference photo wears makeup, replicate it identically in every panel. Same lip color, same eye makeup, same brow grooming. If they wear no makeup, keep all panels makeup-free. Do NOT add, remove, or alter makeup between panels.
- Clothing: the same clothing visible in the reference photo, replicated exactly.
- Accessories: preserve ALL visible accessories from the reference photo (earrings, necklaces, rings, bracelets, piercings, watch, glasses, etc.). Do not omit, resize, recolor, or restyle any accessory. If the person wears prescription glasses (not sunglasses), keep them in every panel.
- Background: plain solid light grey studio backdrop in every panel. No room, no furniture, no environment.
The 12 Hairstyles
1. Pixie cut: very short, textured, slightly tousled on top with tapered sides and nape
2. Classic bob: chin-length, straight, blunt ends, clean middle part
3. Long layered waves: past the shoulders, soft voluminous waves with face-framing layers
4. Sleek low bun: hair pulled back smoothly into a tight low bun at the nape, no flyaways
5. Curtain bangs with medium-length hair: soft parted fringe framing the face, hair falling just past the shoulders
6. High ponytail: hair pulled up into a sleek high ponytail, smooth crown, length falling behind
7. French bob: short bob ending at the jawline with a soft blunt micro-fringe across the forehead
8. Long straight hair with middle part: very long, sleek, pin-straight, falling well past the shoulders
9. Shaggy wolf cut: medium length, heavy layers, choppy fringe, textured and voluminous with a slightly wild look
10. Elegant updo: hair swept up into a polished chignon with soft face-framing tendrils
11. Short curly crop: short voluminous curls all over, natural texture, tapered at the sides
12. Side-swept Hollywood waves: long glamorous deep side part, sculpted vintage waves cascading over one shoulder
Photographic Specs
Shot on a Canon EOS R5 with an 85mm f/1.4 lens, studio portrait lighting (soft key light, subtle fill), shallow depth of field with sharp focus on the face. PLAIN SOLID LIGHT GREY STUDIO BACKGROUND in every panel. Natural skin rendering with visible pores and realistic hair strands (no plastic or CGI look). Consistent lighting, color grading and exposure across all 12 panels. Photorealistic, high detail, hyperrealistic, 8K. No illustration, no painterly effect, no over-smoothing. NO SUNGLASSES.
Each panel clearly numbered 1 to 12 in the top-left corner. Overall output aspect ratio 4:5.

cases.title: 红光干扰实验人像海报
cases.prompt_zh:
【使用方式】根据上传的参考图生成新肖像，保持人脸特征与身份不变。
【主体】成人近景或半身肖像，人物占据画面主体，保留真实面部特征、自然肤质、真实发丝与清晰情绪，轮廓有力；先成立为一张时尚摄影，再叠加图形干预
【服装造型】无特殊要求，以编辑大片感的简洁时装造型为主
【场景背景】中性深色调空间，画面只保留少量细线、圆圈或开口角标等 subtle 图形细节；排版为构图的一部分：一个主导大标题，字母可出血裁切、与人物重叠、藏于身体之后或与干预效果互动，另配一条小号系列标签与一句短文案
【灯光】以黑、白、灰、炭灰等中性色为主，只加一个强调色；肤色保持自然，避免过度暖黄调色
【风格质感】实验编辑风海报（9:16）：只选一种主要干预手法——色彩分割（半透明色带错位揭示）、窄光束（一道光切过面部并延伸至空间）、横向切割（粗横带打断画面并与大字互动）或动态面纱（主体锐利、局部带水平运动拖影）；高级时尚编辑与当代摄影海报气质，干净、克制、平衡，避免多重特效、密集文字、 glitch 与模板感
cases.prompt_en:
Create a medium-sized 9:16 experimental editorial portrait poster using the following customizable inputs:

Subject: [Adult Male or Female Portrait]
Interference: [Color Split / Narrow Light Beam / Horizontal Cut / Motion Veil]
Title: [Title]
Palette: [Main Neutral Tones + One Accent Color]
Mood: [Sharp / Cinematic / Restrained / Experimental]

Create a striking close-up or waist-up portrait with the subject occupying a strong portion of the frame. Preserve realistic facial features, natural skin texture, authentic hair, realistic proportions, clear emotion, and a strong silhouette. The portrait must work visually as a fashion photograph before the graphic intervention is applied.

Use only one primary interference method:

Color Split: Uneven translucent bands selectively shift, reveal, separate, or distort portions of the portrait.

Narrow Light Beam: A single controlled beam cuts across the face or body and continues naturally into the surrounding space.

Horizontal Cut: Bold horizontal bands interrupt selected areas of the portrait and interact with oversized typography.

Motion Veil: Keep the main portrait sharp while selected areas create subtle horizontal photographic motion trails.

Make typography an integral part of the composition. Use one dominant headline, allowing letters to crop beyond the frame, overlap the subject, disappear behind the body, or interact with the interference.

Keep supporting text minimal: one small series label and one short phrase.

Use mostly black, white, grey, charcoal, or deep neutral tones, plus one accent color. Keep skin tones natural and avoid excessive warmth or yellow grading.

Add only a few subtle graphic details such as fine lines, circles, or open corner marks when necessary.

The final composition should feel like a premium fashion editorial, contemporary photography poster, or experimental art-direction piece—clean, intentional, sophisticated, and visually balanced.

Avoid multiple competing effects, dense text, UI elements, heavy glitches, random collage, excessive decoration, numbering, “Vol.” or “Issue” labels, sparkle symbols, logos, watermarks, distorted anatomy, plastic skin, oversaturation, and generic template aesthetics.

Keep the overall treatment medium in scale, refined, adaptable, and universally applicable to different people, titles, themes, palettes, and editorial concepts.

cases.title: 手绘涂鸦时尚人物插画
cases.prompt_zh:
【使用方式】根据上传的参考图生成新肖像，保持人脸特征与身份不变。
【主体】把参考图人物变成可爱古怪的手绘涂鸦角色：大头小身、圆润面部、点点眼与小嘴，脸颊带淡淡的粉色腮红，辨识度高的面部特征、发型与脸型保留并简化；头发用大量松散速写线表现，姿态自然放松
【服装造型】保留参考图的服装与配饰，简化为涂鸦造型，带密集涂写细节
【场景背景】白色或米白色干净背景，大量留白，无多余元素
【灯光】无特殊要求，极简阴影处理
【风格质感】极简儿童故事书 / 时尚速写美学：松散不完美的黑色墨线、可见铅笔涂写笔触、 subtle 交叉排线，局部手绘淡彩（水彩/蜡笔感），手工温度感强；避免抛光矢量与 3D 卡通感
cases.prompt_en:
Transform the subject from the reference image into a cute, quirky hand-drawn doodle illustration.

Use a minimalist children’s storybook / fashion sketch aesthetic with loose, imperfect black ink lines, visible scribbly pencil strokes, subtle cross-hatching, and a charming handmade feel. Keep the character’s recognizable facial features, hairstyle, face shape, clothing, accessories, and overall identity from the reference while simplifying them into a cute illustrated character.

Character design:
- Oversized head and small simplified body
- Simple dot-like eyes and tiny minimal mouth
- Soft rounded facial features
- Slight rosy pink blush on the cheeks
- Messy, expressive hand-drawn hair with many loose sketch lines
- Slightly exaggerated, playful proportions
- Natural, relaxed pose with a whimsical fashion-illustration feel

Art style:
- Black-and-white pencil/ink doodle drawing
- Rough, imperfect sketch lines rather than clean digital outlines
- Dense scribbled hair and clothing details
- Light hand-colored accents
- Subtle watercolor/crayon-like coloring
- Minimal shading
- White or off-white clean background
- Lots of negative space
- Cute, innocent, playful, cozy aesthetic
- Looks like an original handmade notebook/fashion doodle illustration

Preserve the important details of the reference image while converting everything into this consistent doodle-art style. The final image should feel hand-sketched, slightly imperfect, adorable, expressive, and effortlessly stylish, not like polished vector art or 3D cartoon art.

cases.title: 实拍背景涂鸦人物
cases.prompt_zh:
【使用方式】根据上传的参考图生成新肖像，保持人脸特征与身份不变。
【主体】只把照片中的人物替换成可爱手绘涂鸦角色：圆大头、小巧身体、短手短脚、涂写头发、点点眼；严格保留原人物的人数、位置、相对比例、朝向（正/背/侧面不旋转、不臆造看不见的脸）、姿势手势与互动关系，发型、服装颜色与主要配饰保留
【服装造型】保留原服装的颜色与大类，简化为涂鸦造型，蜡笔/彩铅涂写填充，不均匀上色带白色间隙
【场景背景】背景完全保留原实拍照片：天空、建筑、水面、家具、地面、植物、光线、色彩、透视与机位不变，不做任何插画化处理；涂鸦人物与实景在比例、地面接触、纵深与遮挡上自然融合，可触碰或手持真实物体
【灯光】无特殊要求，沿用原照片真实光影
【风格质感】松散天真的手绘涂鸦风：细而抖的黑色描边、重叠速写线、涂鸦式彩铅/蜡笔填充；整体效果像真人被从照片中替换成手绘小人儿，避免全画面插画化、动漫、3D 卡通与矢量线条感
cases.prompt_en:
Transform ONLY the people in the uploaded photo into adorable hand-drawn doodle characters while keeping the original photographic background unchanged.

CORE RULE:
Background = original realistic photo.
People = cute hand-drawn doodle characters.

PRESERVE THE BACKGROUND:
Keep the original sky, landscape, buildings, water, furniture, ground, plants, railings, objects, lighting, colors, perspective, camera angle, framing, and textures as close to the original photo as possible.

Do NOT redraw, simplify, illustrate, or apply doodle/crayon/pencil effects to the background or environmental objects.

TRANSFORM ONLY PEOPLE:
Replace each person with a charming, naive doodle version while preserving:
- exact number of people
- original position and relative scale
- front/back/side/three-quarter orientation
- head and body direction
- pose and gesture
- arm and leg positions
- interactions with people or objects
- hairstyle, clothing colors, and major accessories

IMPORTANT:
If someone faces away, keep them back-facing.
If sideways, keep them sideways.
If facing forward, keep them forward.
Never rotate a person toward the viewer or invent a face that is not visible.

CUTE DOODLE STYLE:
Freely reinterpret realistic anatomy into an adorable, imperfect character:
- oversized round head
- tiny compact body
- short simplified arms and legs
- tiny hands and feet
- cute awkward proportions
- loose scribbled hair
- tiny dot eyes and simple facial features when visible
- rosy scribbled cheeks when appropriate

Keep the original pose recognizable, but simplify and slightly exaggerate it for cuteness.

DRAWING STYLE:
Loose naive hand-drawn doodle, like a quick children's sketch.
Use thin shaky black outlines, imperfect shapes, overlapping sketch lines, scribbled colored-pencil or crayon fills, uneven coloring, white gaps, and slightly messy edges.

The character should look intentionally roughly drawn but extremely cute.

OBJECTS:
Objects, furniture, scenery, and items around the people should remain photographic whenever possible. A doodle character may naturally touch or hold a real photographic object.

INTEGRATION:
Keep correct scale, ground contact, depth, and occlusion so the doodle characters naturally occupy the same locations as the original people.

FINAL LOOK:
It should feel like the real people were removed from the original photograph and replaced with adorable little hand-drawn doodle versions of themselves, while the real-world background remained untouched.

Prioritize:
1. Original photographic background
2. Person position and scale
3. Exact body orientation
4. Pose and gesture
5. Cute exaggerated doodle character design

Avoid full-image illustration, background doodling, realistic anatomy, anime, manga, 3D cartoon, polished digital art, vector lines, changed poses, changed orientation, added people, or invented faces.

cases.title: 云朵气球山脊旅行人像
cases.prompt_zh:
【使用方式】根据上传的参考图生成新肖像，保持人脸特征与身份不变。
【主体】全身竖版人像，人物自然站在草地山脊上，身体微侧、面朝镜头；一只手轻握多根白色细绳，绳子上方连着一朵漂浮在头顶的巨大蓬松白云，如气球花束；另一只手自然垂放身侧；保留原发型发色，几缕发丝随山风轻扬
【服装造型】端庄优雅的全身覆盖造型：浅蓝色飘逸长款连衣裙至脚踝，宽松长袖、高领口、不透明面料，白色平底休闲鞋，小号编织斜挎包，圆形深色墨镜
【场景背景】高海拔山地景观，层叠的蓝绿色远山延伸至地平线，脚下天然草甸点缀野草，天空开阔占据画面上半
【灯光】明亮的正午自然阳光，柔和大气照明，白云与裙摆上有真实高光，阴影自然，蓝天对比清透
【风格质感】超写实专业旅行时尚摄影，真实肤质与布料细节，物理准确的光影与景深，电影级大气透视，高动态范围；色板为天蓝、柔白、粉蓝、草绿与远山蓝，梦幻空灵的夏日氛围，9:16 竖版、人物略低于画面中心
cases.prompt_en:
Create a dreamy ultra-photorealistic outdoor fashion photograph based on the person in @image1.

IDENTITY & FACE:
Preserve the exact facial identity of the person in @image1. Keep the same face shape, facial proportions, eyes, eyebrows, nose, lips, skin tone, hairstyle, hairline, and all recognizable facial features. The person must remain clearly recognizable and consistent with the reference image. Do not redesign or replace the face.

POSE & COMPOSITION:
Create a full-body vertical portrait of the person standing naturally on a grassy mountain ridge. The body is slightly turned toward the camera while the face looks naturally toward the viewer. One hand gently holds several long white strings attached to an enormous fluffy white cloud floating directly above the person like a whimsical balloon bouquet. The other hand rests naturally beside the body.

SCENE:
A breathtaking high-altitude mountain landscape with layers of distant blue-green mountains stretching across the horizon. The subject stands on a natural grassy ridge with delicate wild grass around her feet. Vast open sky dominates the upper portion of the composition.

CLOUD BALLOON:
Create one enormous soft white cumulus cloud directly above the subject, visually resembling a giant floating cloud balloon. Multiple thin white strings descend from the cloud and gather elegantly into the person's hand. The strings should look physically believable and naturally connected to the cloud. The cloud is fluffy, voluminous, bright white, and beautifully illuminated by sunlight.

CLOTHING:

cases.prompt_en:
Use the single uploaded photo as the only visual reference. Transform the person into an adorable hand-drawn 2D children’s storybook character, while keeping their identity immediately recognizable.

Preserve exactly from the photo:
- Facial features and skin tone
- Real hairstyle, length, texture, and color
- Exact clothing, colors, patterns, and layering
- Glasses, jewelry, headwear, bags, and all visible accessories

Do not invent or copy hairstyles, outfits, accessories, braids, pigtails, bows, bonnets, or headscarves from any reference artwork.

### Character
Use an oversized rounded head, tiny compact body, short arms, narrow shoulders, soft rounded silhouette, and cute childlike proportions. Keep the head visually dominant. Avoid realistic anatomy.

### Face
Simplify into tiny dot/oval eyes, minimal nose, tiny smiling mouth, rounded cheeks, and soft peach/pink blush. Keep recognizable facial characteristics. No realistic eyes, detailed lips, anime features, glossy 3D rendering, or heavy shading.

### Hair & Clothing
Recreate the exact hairstyle and outfit from the uploaded photo, simplified into chunky hand-drawn shapes. Preserve important colors, patterns, jewelry, glasses, and other recognizable details.

### Style
Handmade 2D picture-book aesthetic using soft gouache, wax crayon, colored pencil, and dry pastel. Use slightly irregular dark-brown linework, subtle paper grain, uneven pigment, soft brush marks, and imperfect painted edges. Avoid clean vector art, CGI, anime, or photorealism.

### Composition
Square 1:1 portrait, chest/waist-up, centered and facing mostly forward, with balanced negative space. Use a relaxed, charming pose.

### Background
Simple warm mustard, butter yellow, ochre, or cream background with subtle paper texture. No scenery, objects, text, borders, or distractions.

Final feeling: the same person lovingly redrawn as an extremely cute, warm, wholesome, nostalgic, handcrafted children’s-book character—same identity, same hair, same clothes, same accessories, completely simplified and adorable.

cases.prompt_en: Edit the provided image while preserving the same face identity, shape, and facial features without altering age, ethnicity, or structure. Maintain a calm, relaxed expression with the subject not looking at the camera. Subject: young woman (18-23) with soft feminine beauty, smooth glowing skin. Pose: seated on a wooden chair, body angled sideways 45-70 degrees, legs crossed naturally, upper body slightly leaning forward, holding a drink cup with a straw using both hands. cases.title: 迷你分身拼贴

cases.prompt_en: Transform the provided reference image into a cozy aesthetic scrapbook-style composition while strictly preserving the original subject, identity, pose, lighting, and background. Add multiple small mini version characters of the same person (chibi / doll-like style), placed naturally around the scene (on objects, table, shoulder, etc.). These mini figures must match the subject's face, hairstyle, outfit, and vibe consistently, styled as cute 3D collectible figurines. Show them doing different activities (reading, posing, taking photos, relaxing). Overlay handwritten-style doodles and annotations: arrows, hearts, stars, sparkles, icons, playful captions connected to elements. Soft pastel color palette (white base with pink, peach, blue accents). Visually rich but balanced and clean. Warm cozy lighting, dreamy Instagram scrapbook aesthetic, soft depth of field, highly detailed, polished but playful. The final result must look like the SAME original image enhanced with mini alter-egos and aesthetic annotations, not a recreated scene.

cases.prompt_en: A cinematic character promotional poster of the subject, vertical composition (9:16), designed with a refined East-Asian ink aesthetic and high-end visual storytelling. Top-heavy hierarchical layout: the upper half features a large, highly recognizable silhouette of the subject's head, face, or upper body. The middle-lower section contains the full-body version as the secondary subject in a stable pose. Inside the large silhouette and around the character, use double exposure and collage storytelling: key scenes, symbolic imagery, environment, small narrative figures. Blend seamlessly using clouds, mist, ink diffusion, and negative space. Continuous flowing visual path from top to bottom. Balanced supporting elements on left and right. Style: large areas of negative space, ink-wash diffusion edges, Eastern aesthetic balance of emptiness and detail, calm premium restrained cinematic tone. Ultra-detailed, high resolution, layered depth, soft lighting, atmospheric perspective. 9:16 poster-ready composition.

cases.prompt_en: A hyper-realistic cinematic selfie of a woman using her exact reference identity, preserving identical facial features, skin texture, hair, glasses, age and gender from the uploaded reference image, with no synthetic or sculptural skin. Her head tilts slightly toward the camera with a natural, relaxed expression; her full body is visible from head to toe with feet clearly touching the road surface. Extreme top-down camera angle above the subject at a real urban intersection with a pedestrian crosswalk, road markings, traffic signs, cars, bicycles and pedestrians at realistic human scale. Forced perspective makes the woman appear extremely giant while buildings reach no higher than her knees, the subject visually dominating the scene while remaining physically believable. Natural daylight under a clear or lightly cloudy sky with soft, realistic shadows, no fantasy or dramatic lighting. Maximum photorealism with clear separation of foreground, subject and background. No AI-art look, no plastic or sculpted skin, no distortion of face or body, no extra limbs or incorrect anatomy, no text or watermarks. Aspect ratio 9:16.

cases.prompt_en: Ultra-realistic iPhone 15 Pro front-camera selfie of an adult woman on a bright beach, photographed from a raised-arm high-angle selfie perspective. 【风格质感】韩系杂志人像质感，柔和色调，细腻颗粒与轻微柔和感，低调安静、放松非摆拍的氛围，写实外观。
cases.prompt_en: 9:16 vertical, editorial portrait, single subject. Soft black mist filter, subtle haze, gentle highlight bloom, muted tones. Minimal indoor space, clean background, slight texture. Young Korean woman, minimal makeup, natural skin texture. Outfit: fitted ribbed knit top or soft camisole layered under a loose shirt, paired with high-waisted shorts or skirt; fabric slightly clings to body shape, soft and natural, no revealing elements. Hair: slightly messy, natural volume. Pose: sitting on floor with one leg bent and the other relaxed, body slightly leaning, shoulders not aligned, head tilted. Composition: subject slightly off-center, negative space present. Expression: calm, slightly distant, natural lips. Lighting: soft side light, gentle shadow falloff. Mood: understated, quiet, subtly sensual through natural body lines, relaxed and unposed. Quality: fine grain, slight softness, realistic look.

cases.title: 武则天发微博趣味自拍
cases.prompt_zh:
【使用方式】根据上传的参考图生成新肖像，保持人脸特征与身份不变。
【主体】唐代女皇武则天形象，凤冠霞帔、妆容威严华贵，手持智能手机高举自拍，表情带一点得意与好奇，形成古今反差的趣味画面。
【服装造型】唐代皇后礼服：金凤冠、明黄织金龙凤纹袍服、珍珠流苏耳饰。
【场景背景】金碧辉煌的唐代宫殿内景，龙椅与宫灯作背景，自拍广角视角。
【灯光】宫殿暖金烛光与手机屏幕冷光混合，面部带屏幕补光。
【风格质感】写实与趣味混搭风格，像一张真实发布的社交媒体自拍截图，带微博界面元素（头像、昵称、发布时间）。
cases.prompt_en: Wu Zetian taking a selfie, registering and posting on Weibo.

cases.title: 清冷佳人夜市烧烤三刀流
cases.prompt_zh:
【使用方式】根据上传的参考图生成新肖像，保持人脸特征与身份不变。
【主体】气质清冷孤傲的绝美佳人，精致面部特征，冷峻高级的时装脸，长发，优雅苗条身材；标志性烧烤「三刀流」姿势：嘴里叼一根烤串，双手各持一根烤串交叉，模仿索隆三刀流，动态表情生动。
【服装造型】时髦高端的网红风时尚穿搭，简洁利落，衬托清冷气质。
【场景背景】街头夜市夜景，背景虚化的人间烟火摊位，低角度广角镜头。
【灯光】温暖黄色夜市灯光，柔焦光晕，电影级光照，暗调情绪化氛围，浅景深。
【风格质感】胶片质感写实摄影，电影叙事感，肌肤清晰发光、发丝细致，超高清 8K 极致细节。
cases.prompt_en: A stunning beauty with a cool, aloof atmosphere, delicate facial features, a cold and sophisticated high-fashion face, long hair, and a graceful slender figure; barbecue 'three-sword style' pose: one barbecue skewer held in her mouth, one skewer in each hand crossed to mimic Zoro's three-sword style; street night scene ambiance, warm yellow night market lighting, blurred background, film-like texture, soft-focus glow, cinematic storytelling feel, trendy high-end influencer-style fashion shoot, clear luminous skin, sharply detailed strands of hair, lively dynamic expression, low-angle wide-angle shot, moody dark-toned atmosphere, shallow depth of field, ultra HD 8K, extreme detail, cinematic lighting.

cases.title: 本人真人风角色设定图
cases.prompt_zh:
【使用方式】根据上传的参考图生成新肖像，保持人脸特征与身份不变。
【主体】以参考图人物本人为主角，将其转化为游戏/动漫式角色设定图：保留本人面部特征与发型，正面全身立绘为主图，旁配三视图（正面、侧面、背面）与表情差分小头像。
【服装造型】根据本人日常穿搭风格设计角色服装，保留标志性单品与配色，服装结构清晰便于参考绘制。
【场景背景】纯色或浅灰设定图背景，版式整洁的信息图排版，含角色名、属性栏与配色色卡区。
【灯光】均匀平光，无强烈阴影，保证服装与五官细节清晰可读。
【风格质感】半写实角色设定稿风格，线条干净，类似官方角色资料页（character sheet），附简短角色介绍文案。
cases.prompt_en: Create a character reference sheet of the person in the reference image, presented as if they were a fictional character, in a conversational 'ChatGPT voice' explainer style.

cases.title: VTuber真人风周边图

【风格质感】真人实拍（live-action）风格的电商周边宣传图，画面清晰，带价格牌或标题留白方便排版。
cases.prompt_en: Create fan goods for a standard VTuber character in live-action style.

cases.title: 战国武将角色设定表

cases.title: 四格讽刺产品广告图

【灯光】明亮自然的广告摄影光线，色彩干净。
【风格质感】日式幽默讽刺广告图鉴风格，排版密集但整齐，带小字卖点列表与规格说明。

cases.title: 黑白湿发男士特写肖像
cases.prompt_zh:
【使用方式】根据上传的参考图生成新肖像，保持人脸特征与身份不变。
【主体】英俊的年轻亚洲男子近景特写，凌乱湿发贴在额前，面部与颈部布满细腻的水珠与汗珠，目光强烈而忧郁地望向画面左侧外，下颌线 sharp，嘴唇饱满。
【服装造型】无特殊服装要求，特写构图以面部与颈部为主。
【场景背景】纯黑背景，水珠在皮肤上形成 specular 高光。
【灯光】戏剧性高对比光影，电影级 chiaroscuro 明暗对照，突出湿润肌肤的反光与轮廓。
【风格质感】黑白摄影，写实高时尚编辑风，电影质感，皮肤纹理极致细腻。
cases.prompt_en: A striking black and white close-up portrait of a handsome young Asian man with messy wet hair sticking to his forehead. His face and neck are glistening, covered in highly detailed water droplets and sweat. He has an intense, melancholic gaze directed off-camera to the left. The lighting is dramatic and high-contrast, emphasizing his sharp jawline, full lips, and specular highlights on the wet skin against a pitch-black background. Shot in a photorealistic, high-fashion editorial style with cinematic chiaroscuro.

cases.title: 紫白大小姐VTuber档案页
cases.prompt_zh:

cases.title: 红叶和服回眸人像
cases.prompt_zh:

【主体】年轻日本女性回眸望向镜头，温柔微笑；深色头发盘成优雅发髻，几缕碎发垂在脸侧，佩戴小巧珍珠耳饰。

【风格质感】写实人像摄影，浅景深与 soft bokeh，电影感构图，肤质与和服纹理细腻真实。
cases.prompt_en: A photorealistic portrait with shallow depth of field and soft bokeh of a young Japanese woman looking back over her shoulder at the camera with a gentle smile. She is wearing a light beige kimono with orange maple leaf patterns and a gold obi. Her dark hair is styled in an elegant updo with loose strands framing her face, and she wears small pearl earrings. The background features an autumn garden with vibrant red maple leaves, with bright red foliage framing the top left and a heavily blurred, soft background creating a serene, cinematic atmosphere.

cases.title: 动漫风校园少女低角度人像
cases.prompt_zh:
【使用方式】根据上传的参考图生成新肖像，保持人脸特征与身份不变。
【主体】年轻女子蹲下身，从低角度微微俯视镜头；长而飘逸的灰金色头发随风轻扬，苍白皮肤，大而 expressive 的眼睛；双臂自然搭在膝盖上。
【服装造型】日式校服：浅灰色开衫、白色衬衫、深色格纹领结、深色格纹百褶裙、深色过膝袜、黑色皮质乐福鞋。
【场景背景】明亮晴空，散布白云，画面底部可见虚化的铁丝网围栏与绿树，校园操场氛围。
【灯光】明亮自然日光，柔和电影感阴影，突出服装与皮肤的真实纹理。
【风格质感】高度细腻的写实动漫风人像摄影，动漫面容与真实质感融合，画面清新明亮。
cases.prompt_en: A highly detailed, photorealistic anime-style portrait of a young woman crouching down and looking slightly down at the camera from a low angle. She has long, flowing ash-blonde hair blowing gently in the wind, pale skin, and large, expressive eyes. She is wearing a Japanese school uniform with a light grey cardigan, white shirt, dark plaid bow tie, dark plaid pleated skirt, dark knee-high socks, and black leather loafers. Her arms are resting casually on her knees. The background is a bright clear blue sky with scattered white clouds, with a blurred chain-link fence and green trees visible at the very bottom, suggesting a schoolyard. The lighting is bright, natural daylight with soft, cinematic shadows, emphasizing the realistic textures of her clothing and skin.

cases.title: 传统哥特风改妆造型
cases.prompt_zh:
【使用方式】根据上传的参考图生成新肖像，保持人脸特征与身份不变。
【主体】基于参考图人物进行造型改造：保持原姿势、服装结构与背景不变，将整体外观转换为传统哥特（trad goth）美学；肤色略微变苍白，面部加两个穿孔：鼻中隔环与鼻翼钉。
【服装造型】保留原服装结构，多层项链改造为倒十字与五角星吊坠款式。
【场景背景】与参考图完全一致的原场景背景，不做更换。
【灯光】与参考图一致的光线条件，仅配合苍白肤色微调。
【风格质感】传统哥特风：黑色凌乱碎刘海（choppy bangs），浓重暗色妆容，黑色唇膏与强烈深色眼影。
cases.prompt_en: Using the reference image, transform the subject's appearance to a trad goth aesthetic while preserving the exact pose, clothing structure, and background. Change her hair to black with choppy bangs. Apply heavy dark makeup, specifically black lipstick and intense dark eyeshadow, and make her skin tone slightly paler. Add 2 facial piercings: a septum ring and a nostril stud. Finally, modify her layered necklaces to feature an inverted cross and a pentagram pendant.

cases.title: 女仆装拍立得照片墙
cases.prompt_zh:
【使用方式】根据上传的参考图生成新肖像，保持人脸特征与身份不变。
【主体】同一位少女的 10 张拍立得照片集合：长粉色头发带蓝色内层挑染，红粉色眼眸；每张姿势不同——抱粉色爱心抱枕、眨眼比剪刀手、比手心、托腮微笑、抱红玫瑰、指尖抵唇害羞、抱粉色小蛋糕、手边带签名与涂鸦、抱粉色兔子玩偶等，部分照片边框带手写签名「Hanashi」与爱心涂鸦。
【服装造型】黑白女仆装，配蕾丝发带与黑色蝴蝶结。
【场景背景】拍立得照片两排五张平铺在白色织物表面上展示。
【灯光】柔和均匀的平铺拍摄光线，照片色彩粉嫩明亮。
【风格质感】即时成像照片拼贴风格，少女偶像周边感，粉彩色调。

cases.title: MC本人像素皮肤

【灯光】均匀平光，像素块面清晰无阴影干扰。
【风格质感】标准 Minecraft 皮肤贴图风格，64x64 像素规格观感。
cases.prompt_en: Create a Minecraft skin inspired by my look.

cases.title: 雷电将军漫展Cos自拍

cases.prompt_en: Genshin Impact Raiden Shogun cosplay selfies at the Shanghai Comic Con.

cases.title: 奢华香水瓶（产品图：多语言文字）
cases.prompt_zh: 奢华香水产品摄影：透明玻璃瓶装着浅金色液体，放在白色大理石台面上，自然左侧柔光照射产生柔和阴影与清晰的玻璃折射，背景为干净的浅米色。右下角品牌名「AURA」必须清晰锐利，整体风格简约奢华，文字必须清晰。
cases.prompt_en: A commercial photograph of a luxury perfume bottle: a transparent glass bottle with pale golden liquid, placed on a white marble surface, natural side lighting coming from the left, producing soft shadows and clear glass refraction, with a clean light-beige background. The brand name 'AURA' appears in the lower right corner. Text must be crisp, overall style minimal and luxurious.

cases.title: OFFSET 日本街头时尚杂志封面（多元素复杂排版）
cases.prompt_zh: 基于 REFERENCE_0 作为人像源，将它转换为一页高端日式编辑风杂志封面，同时保留人物、姿势、帽子、衬衫、光照方向、阴影与脸部模糊处理。裁剪更紧、做成竖版封面布局，将人物放在稍偏右中心位置。叠加颗粒感米白纸张纹理、粗体黑色紧凑字体、霓虹黄绿色强调条。杂志标题为 {argument name="magazine title" default="OFFSET"}，以巨大黑色字体横排顶部，部分压在人物头后。右上角写期号 {argument name="issue line" default="ISSUE 07 / OCT 2026"}。左缘竖排一条霓虹绿色条带，含日文文案 {argument name="left vertical tagline" default="静けさは、時に最も鋭い。"}。左下放主封面大标题 {argument name="main cover headline" default="QUIET PROVOCATION"}，下方黄底副标题 {argument name="subtitle" default="Stillness cuts deeper than noise."}。左列精确包含 5 条编号小预告：01 FORM / PATTERN / RESTRAINT；02 THE NEW CODE OF SOFT POWER；03 CITY UNIFORM, REWRITTEN；04 SHADOW PLAY IN SILVER THREAD；05 INTERVIEW: ON STYLE WITHOUT PERFORMANCE。底部加 1 个条形码块带价格「¥1200 (税込)」。右上 1 个竖排日文金句块：「装うことは、主張ではなく編集である。」右下放 1 个黑白城市建筑小图嵌入，配霓虹绿侧条点缀。底部右下、边缘配 3 处微小编辑部文字丛：「OBSERVE. EDIT. INTENT. REPEAT.」 / 「CITY AS TEXTURE. SILENCE AS LANGUAGE. STYLE AS EDIT.」 / 页码下方小段说明。底部右端放 1 个巨大页码「014」（霓虹黄绿色）。保持日式街头极简高级版风，含真实印刷颗粒、轻度墨迹磨损、强对比。
cases.prompt_en: Using REFERENCE_0 as the portrait source, transform it into a high-end editorial fashion magazine cover while preserving the person, pose, hat, shirt, lighting direction, shadow, and face-obscuring blur. Crop closer into a vertical cover layout and place the subject slightly right of center. Add a gritty off-white paper texture, bold black condensed typography, and neon yellow-green accent bars. Create a magazine cover titled {argument name="magazine title" default="OFFSET"} in huge black letters across the top, partially behind the subject's head. Add the issue line at upper right: {argument name="issue line" default="ISSUE 07 / OCT 2026"}. Add a vertical neon-green strip at the far left with Japanese copy: {argument name="left vertical tagline" default="静けさは、時に最も鋭い。"}. Add a large bottom-left cover headline: {argument name="main cover headline" default="QUIET PROVOCATION"}, with the yellow subtitle {argument name="subtitle" default="Stillness cuts deeper than noise."}. Include exactly 5 numbered article teasers in a left column: 01 FORM / PATTERN / RESTRAINT; 02 THE NEW CODE OF SOFT POWER; 03 CITY UNIFORM, REWRITTEN; 04 SHADOW PLAY IN SILVER THREAD; 05 INTERVIEW: ON STYLE WITHOUT PERFORMANCE. Add exactly 1 barcode block with price text "¥1200 (税込)" under it. Add exactly 1 vertical Japanese quote block on the upper right: "装うことは、主張ではなく編集である。". Add exactly 1 small black-and-white city-building photo inset on the lower right with a neon-green side accent. Add exactly 3 tiny editorial text clusters on the lower/right area: "OBSERVE. EDIT. INTENT. REPEAT.", "CITY AS TEXTURE. SILENCE AS LANGUAGE. STYLE AS EDIT.", and a small paragraph under page number. Add exactly 1 large page number "014" in neon yellow-green at the bottom right. Keep the design minimalist, modern, Japanese street-fashion magazine style, with realistic print grain, slightly distressed ink, and strong contrast.

cases.title: 建筑平面图 → 立体可居住微缩（Prompt Studio）
cases.prompt_zh: 建筑平面图（Prompt Studio）：一张 [建筑类型] 的建筑平面图铺展在制图桌上，空间向上隆起成为可居住的微缩。[房间1] 浮现，配 [家具1] 和正在进行的 [活动1]；[房间2] 升起，配 [设计元素] 和 [人类瞬间]；[房间3] 推出，配 [细节1] 和 [灯光1]。墙体同时作为线条与实际隔断。平面图上的视线成为空间之间的真实视野。平面图中的机械系统（HVAC、给排水、电气）脉动着隐形功能。人体流线以幽灵般的运动轨迹显现。建筑比例人偶变成真正微小的居民过着他们微小生活。剖面揭示垂直关系。建筑师的工具环绕：比例尺、铅笔、描图纸。金色设计工作室灯光，平面图作为承诺与证明，8K，建筑作为生命容器。
cases.prompt_en: An architectural floor plan of {BUILDING_TYPE} spread across a drafting table, with the spaces rising into inhabitable miniature. {ROOM_1} emerges with {FURNITURE_1} and {ACTIVITY_1} in progress, {ROOM_2} rises with {DESIGN_ELEMENT} and {HUMAN_MOMENT}, {ROOM_3} pushes up with {DETAIL_1} and {LIGHTING_1}. Walls exist as both lines and actual partitions simultaneously. Sight lines marked on the plan become actual views between spaces. The mechanical systems in the plan, HVAC, plumbing, electrical, pulse with invisible function. Human circulation patterns appear as ghosted movement trails. Architectural scale figures become actual tiny inhabitants living their tiny lives. Section cuts reveal vertical relationships. The architect's tools surround: scales, pencils, trace paper. Golden design studio light, the plan as promise and proof, 8K, architecture as life container.

cases.title: 6 摄像机角度网格：单图变多镜头
cases.prompt_zh: 用 attached image 作为唯一真值来源，创建一张干净的 3 列 × 2 行的网格图——同一场景从 6 个不同摄像机位置拍摄的 6 张照片，仿佛 6 台摄像机在同一瞬间被布置在房间里。锁定 attached image 中的一切：相同的人物/家具/光照/墙上字——只传摄像机移动。得到：（1）宽幅主镜头（同你的原图）；（2）从天花板向下的顶视图；（3）从左侧主体肩上；（4）从右侧主体肩上反向；（5）从地板仰角的三分之四镜头；（6）85mm 特写 + 浅景深。同一张脸、同样的家具、同样的光照、同样的墙上字——只让摄像机移动。适用于播客/室内/产品场景，甚至单人镜头（自动调整）。
cases.prompt_en: Using the attached image as the single source of truth, create ONE image that is a clean 3-column by 2-row grid of six photographs of the EXACT same scene, captured from six different camera positions, as if six cameras were placed around the room at the same instant. Lock everything from the attached image: the same people, same furniture, same lighting, same wall text — only the camera moves. What you get: (1) Wide master shot; (2) Top-down overhead view from the ceiling; (3) Over-the-shoulder from the left subject; (4) Reverse over-the-shoulder from the right subject; (5) Low-angle three-quarter shot from the floor; (6) 85mm close-up with shallow depth of field. Same faces, same furniture, same lighting, same wall text — only the camera moves. Works for podcast sets, interiors, product scenes, even single-person shots (it auto-adjusts).

cases.title: 产品工程蓝图：基于参考图转 orthographic
cases.prompt_zh: 为 Nano Banana Pro 或 GPT Image 设计的 prompt，根据参考图生成详细蓝图：分析上传的参考图以理解物体的机械结构与几何。生成该具体产品的综合工业级蓝图。以专业正射投影方式呈现，包含清晰的平面、立面与剖视图，详细内部与外部构造。将装配分解为各主要组件，并使用标准化无衬线工程字体为每个部件添加清晰可读的技术文本标签（编号）。以经典蓝图美学呈现，配白色矢量线条与深蓝网格背景，确保高对比度与专业精度，适合制造文档。
cases.prompt_en: Analyze the uploaded reference image to understand the mechanical structure and geometry of the object. Generate a comprehensive, industrial-level blueprint of this specific product. Present the design as a professional orthographic projection, featuring clear plan, elevation, and section views to detail the internal and external construction. Deconstruct the assembly into its primary components and apply legible, technical text labels (denominations) for each part using a standardized sans-serif engineering font. Render the visual in a classic blueprint aesthetic with precise white vector-style lines on a deep blue grid background, ensuring high contrast and professional accuracy suitable for manufacturing documentation.

cases.title: 黑白男性 studio portrait with Rembrandt lighting + Roman numeral cuff
cases.prompt_zh: 用 GPT Image 2 在 ChatGPT 上：戏剧性黑白 studio 肖像。自信蓄须男性，戴独特细框金色圆框墨镜配深色镜片，穿剪裁深色西装，特写构图 + 浅景深。主体置于画面右侧，眼平视 85mm portrait lens 镜头，头部转左侧 profile view，平静沉思表情，下巴微抬。左手轻握举至下巴，姿态强度感。灯光为经典 Rembrandt-style side lighting，软而强方向，右脸外侧加颈处深电影阴影，左脸、额头、鼻梁、拳指头发光光。眼睛强 catchlights 必要。肖像感 moody、elegant、editorial，rich tonal contrast + crisp texture detail。胡须精修可见单根毛发 + 真实肤质（毛孔、睫毛、微妙面部纹）。乱发 + 左腕豪华金属表，物理镌制表圈细节 + 抛光手链。深色外套袖口银色 Roman numeral III 竖直粗 serif 风格。金属面料表镜 + 金属边缘自然高光，服装保持哑光。整体调色板仅 monochrome：深黑、亮白、rich greys 极高对比。背景暗色 studio 布幕，柔斑驳纹理渐入近黑阴影，右侧重 vignette。极前景底缘有轻焦点模糊增加真实感。超写实摄影、电影 portrait 风格、豪华时尚 editorial 审美、极致细节胡须纹理、真实肤质微细节、眼睛面部 sharp focus、高动态范围 monochrome 音调、no visible noise、no compression artifacts。
cases.prompt_en: A dramatic black-and-white studio portrait of a confident bearded man wearing unique, thin-framed gold round sunglasses with dark tinted lenses and a tailored dark suit, captured in a close-up composition with a shallow depth of field. He is positioned slightly to the right side of the frame, photographed at eye level with an 85mm portrait lens look. His head is turned to the left in profile view, gazing off-camera with a calm, contemplative expression, chin slightly raised. His left hand is loosely clenched near his chin, adding intensity and sophistication to the pose. The lighting is classic Rembrandt-style side lighting, soft yet highly directional, creating deep cinematic shadows across the right side of his face and neck while illuminating the left side of his face, forehead, nose bridge, and knuckles. Strong catchlights in the eyes are essential. The portrait should feel moody, elegant, and editorial, with rich tonal contrast and crisp texture detail. His beard is meticulously groomed with visible individual hairs and realistic skin texture including pores, eyelashes, and subtle facial lines. He has a messy hair and wears a luxury metal wristwatch on his left wrist with reflective metallic surfaces, visible bezel details, and a polished bracelet. On the cuff of his dark jacket, a silver-toned Roman numeral "III" detail appears vertically in a bold serif style. The suit fabric is matte black with subtle folds and stitched cuff details. The watch crystal and metal edges catch highlights naturally while the clothing remains mostly matte. The overall palette is monochrome only: deep blacks, bright whites, and rich greys with very high contrast. The background is a dark studio backdrop with soft mottled texture fading into near-black shadows and a heavy vignette on the right side. Slight soft-focus blur appears in the extreme foreground near the bottom edge, adding depth and realism. Ultra-realistic photography, cinematic portrait style, luxury fashion editorial aesthetic, extremely detailed beard texture, realistic skin micro-details, sharp focus on the eyes and face, high dynamic range monochrome tones, no visible noise, no compression artifacts.

cases.title: Educational photography lighting tutorial infographic (3×7 flash comparison chart)
cases.prompt_zh: GPT Image 2 on ChatGPT。Prompt：创建清教育摄影灯光教学信息图 minimalist editorial 风格。布局为垂直 comparison chart，3 列 × 7 行。Top headers：左列 Indoors、中列 Indoors、右列 Outdoors；户外 header 旁加小注 no reflective surfaces 加 NO CEILING OUTDOORS。每行 compare 不同 flash 灯光法。展示同一女性 model 黑白对比 × 同一姿势，整张 chart 同一 simple top + 中长 dark 发 + realistic 表情 + classic studio portrait 感。Row 1 DIRECT：左 panel——simple technical lighting diagram showing direct flash aimed at subject；中 panel——indoor 硬 direct flash + 墙锐阴影；右 panel——outdoor 硬影 + 强对比。Row 2 BOUNCE：左——flash bounce off ceiling 灯光 diagram；中——indoor portrait 柔上弹光 + 柔墙影；右——text note 替照片 NO CEILING OUTDOORS。Row 3 LUMIQUEST：左——LumiQuest style bounced/diffused flash 灯光 diagram；中——indoor portrait soft 但 directional light；右——outdoor portrait 暗、defined 阴影。Row 4 OMNIBOUNCE：左——flash scatter multidirectional 灯光 diagram；中——indoor portrait 柔均匀光；右——outdoor portrait 多向反弹光照 + 更显阴影。Row 5 GEL / DIFFUSER 系列；Row 6 SOFTBOX；Row 7 BOUNCE CARD。Design style monochrome / black and white 清教学信息图 + 细黑边框每 panel + 浅灰背景 diagram panels + 简线 art technical diagrams with arrows showing light paths + 真实肖像摄影 example panels + 齐 All caps row labels + magazine quality educational reference sheet + balanced spacing and grid alignment + 高 clarity, easy to understand, professional tutorial layout。
cases.prompt_en:
Create a clean educational photography lighting tutorial infographic in a minimalist editorial style. The layout should be a vertical comparison chart with 3 columns and 7 rows.

Top headers:
Left column: Indoors
Middle column: Indoors
Right column: Outdoors
Include a small note near the outdoor header: no reflective surfaces and also a note saying NO CEILING OUTDOORS.

Each row should compare a different flash lighting method. Show the same female model in black-and-white portrait photos with the same pose across the chart, standing near a plain wall, wearing a simple top, medium-length dark hair, realistic expression, classic studio portrait look.

Row 1: DIRECT
Left panel: a simple technical lighting diagram showing direct flash aimed at the subject.
Middle panel: indoor result with hard direct flash and a sharp shadow on the wall.
Right panel: outdoor result with even harder shadow and stronger contrast.

Row 2: BOUNCE
Left panel: lighting diagram showing flash bouncing off the ceiling.
Middle panel: indoor portrait with softer upward bounced light and a gentler wall shadow.
Right panel: text note instead of photo saying "NO CEILING OUTDOORS".

Row 3: LUMIQUEST
Left panel: lighting diagram for LumiQuest style bounced/diffused flash.
Middle panel: indoor portrait with soft but directional light.
Right panel: outdoor portrait with darker, more defined shadow.

Row 4: OMNIBOUNCE
Left panel: lighting diagram showing flash scattered in multiple directions.
Middle panel: indoor portrait with diffused, room-filled light and softer shadow.
Right panel: outdoor portrait with stronger contrast and shadow because there are no reflective surfaces.

Row 5: THROUGH AN UMBRELLA
Left panel: diagram showing flash shooting through a translucent umbrella toward the subject.
Middle panel: indoor portrait with broad, soft light and smooth shadows.
Right panel: outdoor portrait with soft light on subject but still a noticeable shadow behind.

Row 6: OFF AN UMBRELLA
Left panel: diagram showing flash reflected off a white umbrella.
Middle panel: indoor portrait with soft reflected light and balanced contrast.
Right panel: outdoor portrait with more contrast and deeper background shadow.

Row 7: THROUGH A SOFT BOX
Left panel: diagram showing a rectangular softbox aimed at the subject.
Middle panel: indoor portrait with very soft, even professional lighting.
Right panel: outdoor portrait with soft directional lighting and a more visible shadow than indoors.

Design style:
monochrome / black and white
clean instructional infographic
thin black borders around each panel
light gray background in diagram panels
simple line art technical diagrams with arrows showing light paths
realistic portrait photography in the example panels
neat typography, all caps row labels
magazine quality educational reference sheet
balanced spacing and grid alignment
high clarity, easy to understand, professional tutorial layout.

cases.prompt_en:
Minimalist editorial portrait poster design featuring a confident male athlete shown in perfect side profile, gazing upward with a thoughtful and determined expression. The portrait is rendered in high contrast black and white photography, emphasizing facial structure, beard texture, skin details, and dramatic shadows. At the bottom of the composition, elegant handwritten signature typography in matching red color overlaps the portrait frame, creating a luxury branding feel. Minimalist Swiss design influence, modern sports poster aesthetic, fine art portrait layout, magazine cover quality.
Monochrome portrait with selective color treatment, black and white subject, bold red geometric background, clean white canvas, luxury typography, premium graphic design, contemporary wall art style, sophisticated visual hierarchy, high fashion editorial look, museum poster aesthetic.
Ultra realistic photography, 8K resolution, razor sharp details, professional retouching, balanced composition, dramatic mood, minimalist luxury branding, iconic athlete poster design, modern graphic design masterpiece, vertical 4:5 aspect ratio.

cases.prompt_en: iPhone 15 Pro front selfie, 24mm lens, high-angle POV (first-person perspective), computational photography style with a clear digital readout and deep depth of field. Subject: porcelain doll aesthetic, flawless pale skin, huge ice-blue eyes, small nose, slightly upturned natural-colored lips, expressionless hollow wide-eyed stare, platinum blonde tight double braids, vibrant blue nail polish, wearing a light blue tight stretch-cotton top with an extremely deep ultra-wide V-neck and deep collarbone line. Action: looking up at the camera, blocking the glaring sunlight with one hand. Setting: a vast sandy beach with a blurry horizon in the background. Lighting: high-key bright coastal daylight, 5500K color temperature, strong white-sand reflection fill, even lighting, slightly dewy poreless skin and fine reflective white sand particles. Color science: soft pastel tones, linear neutral colors, high exposure. Negative prompts: heavy shadows, snow, winter clothing, red nails, black top, conservative neckline, film grain.

cases.title: 同场景再拍一张
cases.prompt_zh:
（六段，v1 固定顺序）


根据上传的参考图生成新肖像，保持人脸特征与身份不变。


以参考图中的成年人物为唯一人物参考，严格保持原有的面部特征、脸型、五官、发型发色、肤色、身形比例与个人气质，始终是同一个人，不换脸、不换人。重新设计一个完整、合理且有表现力的动作瞬间：可以是动作进行中的动态状态，也可以是富有感染力的静态瞬间；不要机械套用固定姿势，也不要只改变头部角度或手部位置。自然协调地安排身体重心、躯干旋转、肩部姿态、手部动作、头部角度、视线与面部表情，使它们共同构成一个完整的视觉表达；优先选择自然、自信、优雅、俏皮、活泼、妩媚或轻松随性的状态，避免僵硬摆拍、重复动作和不符合人体力学的姿势。人物占据画面主体，约占画面高度的 70%–90%，优先采用近景、中近景或突出人物的中景；不默认人物居中，根据动作方向、视线、身体姿态和原有环境结构决定人物位置，合理运用前景、背景、环境线条、自然遮挡与空间留白，避免人物过小、背景喧宾夺主、无意义的空旷构图，以及对头部或关键肢体的不合理裁切。


保持参考图原有的服装款式、服装结构、配色与配饰不变，不更换服装。


保持参考图原有的场景与背景不变，不无故重构场景；合理利用人物与环境之间的互动增强层次感和视觉张力。


延续参考图原有的光线逻辑与整体环境氛围，不无故改变天气、光线方向或影调。


高质量的真实人像摄影风格，保留自然的皮肤纹理、真实的头发细节、合理的光影层次、准确的身体结构与自然的景深。每次生成都应像同一场拍摄中出现的另一个独立瞬间：根据动作与场景自主选择相机高度、拍摄距离、拍摄方向及镜头透视（低机位、高机位、平视、侧前方视角、近距离透视或自然的长焦压缩效果），每次只选择真正有助于当前画面的摄影方式，必要时允许适度的透视夸张，但必须保持合理的身体比例与自然的肢体形态，避免畸变和刻意炫技；每张照片应有一个明确的视觉亮点（富有感染力的眼神、独特的身体姿态、自然的动作瞬间、具有张力的透视、鲜明的构图关系，或人物与环境的巧妙互动），不要机械叠加多种摄影技巧，也不要只靠夸张表情或刻意的模特姿势制造吸引力；不必每次改变全部因素，也不要重复使用相同的动作、表情、机位与构图。避免过度磨皮、塑料皮肤、过度锐化、夸张的背景虚化、过度电影化调色及明显的 AI 生成痕迹；照片可以精致，但必须保持自然可信的真实摄影观感。约束成片质量，不限制创作路径。画幅 3:4。最终生成一张独立的全新照片，不添加第二个人物，不生成拼图、九宫格或多画面布局。

【主体】一位年轻成年女性，自然长相，面向镜子站立、臀部微倾、重心一条腿，神态放松；右手拿手机，左臂搭深色外套；直视镜头、眼神温柔带笑意，双颊淡淡粉红，唇带光泽微张；长波浪深棕发自帽下垂落。
【服装造型】森林绿棒球帽正戴，黑色修身罗纹针织短款长袖上衣，白色高腰百褶网球裙，黑色网袜过膝长袜配蕾丝袜口，小黑斜挎包，细银圈耳环、细银项链。
【场景背景】灯光温暖的公寓电梯内，木质镶板与拉丝金属表面，楼层之间安静的一刻。
【灯光】电梯顶灯柔和暖光、金色光晕，手机自拍视角、胸部高度略向下。
【风格质感】3:4 竖版，坦诚自然、亲密暖调、柔焦，写实照片感；不要画面文字、不要水印、不要签名。

cases.strict_ban: 画面文字，水印，签名，网红脸，塑料皮肤，磨皮过度，五官对称到假，手指畸形，多余手指，肢体比例失调，未成年感，真实名人肖像，IP角色，无脸图，9:16或1:1构图。电梯镜面重影错位、帽子遮住眼睛、裙摆变形、包带缠绕。

cases.title: 博物馆油画自己
cases.prompt_zh:
【使用方式】根据上传的参考图生成新肖像，保持人脸特征与身份不变；生成一张 3:4 竖版美术馆人像，照片本身是写实摄影、只有身后的画是油画，人脸清晰自然。
【主体】一位年轻成年女性，自然长相，沉静自信神情，正视镜头；身后挂一幅画着自己的古典油画，油画里的人与本人同一张脸。
【服装造型】简洁深色连衣裙，利落大方。
【场景背景】高端美术馆展厅，抛光地面微反光，大幅鎏金画框古典油画挂在身后。
【灯光】展厅聚光灯打在油画厚涂肌理上，电影感布光，强对比、戏剧阴影。
【风格质感】3:4 竖版，商业摄影质感，写实照片感；不要画面文字、不要水印、不要签名。
cases.strict_ban: 画面文字，水印，签名，网红脸，塑料皮肤，磨皮过度，五官对称到假，手指畸形，多余手指，肢体比例失调，未成年感，真实名人肖像，IP角色，无脸图，9:16或1:1构图。整张图渲成油画、油画里的人与本人不是同一张脸、画框歪斜、展厅杂乱。

cases.title: 晨起刷牙镜前
cases.prompt_zh:
【使用方式】根据上传的参考图生成新肖像，保持人脸特征与身份不变；生成一张 3:4 竖版浴室镜前刷牙日常，人脸清晰自然。
【主体】一位年轻成年女性，自然长相，站在大矩形浴室镜前刷牙，右手持白色电动牙刷，嘴角一点牙膏沫，嘴微张、神情放松，脸与上肩在镜中清晰；中长栗棕发松松束成低马尾，几缕碎发贴脸。
【服装造型】浅灰色纯棉 T 恤，穿着得体。
【场景背景】现代浴室，白色陶瓷洗手池配铬水龙头，台面有牙刷充电器、开口牙膏管、大理石台面带水渍，背景浅色瓷砖墙微虚。
【灯光】顶灯均匀冷白光加镜边暖色化妆灯，皮肤真实高光，下巴微影、眼中有光，唇齿带牙膏湿润光泽。
【风格质感】3:4 竖版，日常手机抓拍感，皮肤毛孔清晰、自然色彩；不要画面文字、不要水印、不要签名。
cases.strict_ban: 画面文字，水印，签名，网红脸，塑料皮肤，磨皮过度，五官对称到假，手指畸形，多余手指，肢体比例失调，未成年感，真实名人肖像，IP角色，无脸图，9:16或1:1构图。镜中倒影错位变形、牙刷插进脸里、泡沫糊满全脸、浴室过暗。

cases.title: 故宫红墙雪景汉服
tags: 场景：故宫红墙长廊雪景
cases.prompt_zh:
【使用方式】根据上传的参考图生成新肖像，保持人脸特征与身份不变；生成一张 3:4 竖版故宫红墙雪景汉服人像，人脸清晰自然。
【主体】一位 20 多岁的成年女性，自然长相，端庄沉静神情，正视镜头；真实皮肤质感、毛孔可见，不磨皮、不过度美化。
【服装造型】明制重工汉服：翡翠绿织金锦底、多色刺绣与盘金绣混用（金、朱红、宝蓝、米白），牡丹团花纹样；内层米白立领、中层对襟袄、外层霞帔礼服结构，马面裙裙摆织金边；金色凤冠、金丝累珠、密集簪钗、左右长流苏。
【场景背景】北京故宫红墙长廊：朱红墙、红柱、雕花窗、彩绘梁枋、强透视纵深；细雪飘落，檐下台阶带残雪，背景干净、无游客、无现代标识。
【灯光】冬日自然光加柔和补光，85mm、浅景深、眼睛最清晰，金饰真实高光不爆。
【风格质感】3:4 竖版，杂志封面级构图、顶部留白，高级电影感、红墙与绿衣干净分离；不要画面文字、不要杂志刊名、不要水印、不要签名。
cases.strict_ban: 画面文字，水印，签名，网红脸，塑料皮肤，磨皮过度，五官对称到假，手指畸形，多余手指，肢体比例失调，未成年感，真实名人肖像，IP角色，无脸图，9:16或1:1构图。出现杂志刊名或文字、红墙与衣服颜色脏染混成一片、凤冠流苏糊掉、雪花成噪点、汉服结构穿帮。

cases.title: 黄昏咖啡馆窗边

cases.strict_ban: 画面文字，水印，签名，网红脸，塑料皮肤，磨皮过度，五官对称到假，手指畸形，多余手指，肢体比例失调，未成年感，真实名人肖像，IP角色，无脸图，9:16或1:1构图。侧脸糊成剪影、咖啡杯变形、胶片颗粒成噪点、窗外光斑过曝。
